# smol-toml 1.9.0

The `*.js` files are `dist/*.js` (the ES modules) from the npm package `smol-toml@1.9.0`, unchanged. BSD-3-Clause licence
(`LICENSE`). Source: https://github.com/squirrelchat/smol-toml (tag v1.9.0). Used by File convert (JSON to TOML, TOML to
JSON: `convert/js/core/structured.js`), loaded on first use.
